name: Logistic Regression
learningObjectives: Understand how the sigmoid function transforms linear predictions into probabilities
Learn how binary cross-entropy loss guides the learning process
Interpret classification metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score
Visualize decision boundaries that separate different classes
Recognize the impact of learning rate and regularization on model performance

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a binary classification dataset to train on

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Controls how quickly the model learns. Higher values converge faster but may be unstable.

controls.label: Epochs
controls.tooltip: Number of training iterations. More epochs allow better learning but take longer.

controls.label: Regularization (L2)
controls.tooltip: Prevents overfitting by penalizing large weights. Higher values create simpler models.

visualizations.title: Classification Data & Decision Boundary
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing the two classes and the decision boundary

visualizations.title: Decision Boundary (Probability Heatmap)
visualizations.description: Heatmap showing the probability of class 1 across the feature space

visualizations.title: Confusion Matrix
visualizations.description: Matrix showing true positives, false positives, true negatives, and false negatives

visualizations.title: Training Loss
visualizations.description: Binary cross-entropy loss over training epochs
